name: IRBESARTAN / HYDROCHLOROTHIAZIDE 150/12.5MG 14 TABLETS
description: Irbesartan controls high blood pressure, but it does not cure the condition. It may take up to 2 weeks before you feel the full benefit of irbesartan. Hydrochlorothiazide is used to treat edema (fluid retention; excess fluid retained in body tissues) caused by various medical problems, including heart, kidney, and liver disease, and to treat edema caused by the use of certain medications. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
